resources.string: Y Walk is a fitness and activity tracker that provides personalized training recommendations. It is not a medical device, is not intended for any medical purpose, and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or health condition.

This app is intended for informational and fitness purposes only. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before beginning any exercise program, especially if you have a medical condition or experience symptoms such as chest pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath.
AI-generated recommendations are provided for informational purposes only and should not replace professional medical or fitness advice.
Before you start, please review and accept the following.
Your workout data stays on your device. Please read the full documents before continuing.

• Activity recognition — to count steps and detect walking vs running.
• Notifications (optional) — for workout reminders if you use a training plan.

Location is optional and only used during active tracking to improve distance accuracy.
I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and I understand the Health and AI disclaimers above.
I confirm that I am at least 13 years old (or the age of digital consent in my country) and that I am physically able to exercise.
You must accept the terms to use Y Walk.
🤖 Botty — your personal coach\nTell me your goal and a bit about you. I\'ll check if it\'s realistic and build a safe plan — never a risky one.
Not medical advice. Botty uses on-device rules based on general training principles. Consult a doctor before starting a new exercise programme. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness, or chest discomfort.

Y Walk needs:

• Activity recognition — to count steps and detect walking vs running.

• Location (optional) — to measure distance more accurately while you track. Denying location still allows step-based tracking.

• Notifications (optional) — for workout reminders if you use a training plan.

Your workout data stays on this device and is not sent to our servers.
Export or restore your data. Nothing is uploaded to Y Walk servers.
